    • validateAdjacentRecursive

      public int validateAdjacentRecursive(TablePosition tablePosition, int i, int j, int count, Boolean[][] batrix, Type type, boolean starting, int score, Boolean[][] occupied)
      This method returns the score of the player based on the number of adjacent cards of the same type. It is a recursive method that counts the number of adjacent cards of the same type through the whole player shelf
      Parameters:
      tablePosition - is the position of the player
      i - is the row of the bookshelf
      j - is the column of the bookshelf
      count - is the number of adjacent cards
      batrix - is a matrix of booleans that indicates if a cell has been already counted for objective
      type - is the type of the card
      starting - true if the current cell is the first of the sequence
      score - the current temporary score computed by the recursion so far
      occupied - is a matrix of booleans that indicates if a cell contains a card
      Returns:
      the score accumulated by the player with adjacent cards of the same type
